name: check_inventory
description: Return the stock position for a single SKU: units available, units reserved against open orders, and the restock date when availability is zero. Use this to confirm a specific variant can be ordered. It takes a SKU, not a product_id; to go from a product to its SKUs, call get_product_detail first.

sku.description: Variant identifier in the form <product_id>-<nn>, e.g. P0007-02.

error_returns.when: No inventory record exists for the given sku.
